record.question: As you sow, so shall you reap.
record.explanation: Answer A: Adverbial Clause of Manner. “As you sow” describes the manner in which you reap (A). Independent check: “As you sow” expresses the manner in which you will reap, as in the proverbial parallel construction. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
